name: Castillo de "Manqueospese" o "Aunquespese"
description:
Construido en las décadas de 1470 y 1480 por Pedro Dávila, señor de Villafranca y Las Navas, decidido partidario de los intereses de la infanta Isabel frente al rey Enrique IV y Juana la Beltraneja. 
Se trata de un ejemplo de castillo serrano o montaraz europeo, de muros fuertes adaptados al terreno rocoso en el que se asienta, se le menciona en documentos de los siglos XI y XII como centro de diversas expediciones guerreras y de reconquista contra los musulmanes.
Según la leyenda, el castillo lo mandaría construir don Raimundo, para comunicarse con su amada doña Guiomar, encerrada en el balcón que corona la puerta del Rastro ( en Ávila, acceso por la casa de los Dávila ) , dada la prohibición del padre de ésta de que la pareja continuase con sus amoríos. Ante la actitud paterna, don Raimundo exclamó: "la veré manqueospese " ó  "la veré aunqueospese", y fue entonces cuando levantó su castillo, desde el que al parecer se comunicaba con su querida Guiomar.

name: Projeto - Fernanda Brasil de Souza Soares
description:
O presente projeto estrutural refere-se a uma edificação residencial unifamiliar de dois pavimentos, concebida em estrutura de concreto armado, dimensionada conforme as normas técnicas brasileiras vigentes.

A estrutura foi projetada para garantir segurança, estabilidade, durabilidade e desempenho adequado ao longo de sua vida útil, considerando as ações permanentes e variáveis atuantes, tais como peso próprio, sobrecargas de uso, ações do vento e demais solicitações previstas em norma.

O sistema estrutural é composto por elementos de fundação, pilares, vigas e lajes maciças em concreto armado, devidamente dimensionados e detalhados. As fundações foram definidas de acordo com as características do solo e cargas transmitidas pela superestrutura, podendo ser do tipo sapatas isoladas, blocos ou outro sistema adequado conforme análise geotécnica.

name: Fahy Church Architectural Frag (CL019-002003-)
description: Architectural fragment from the medieval church of Fahy (CL019-002001-), consisting of a chamfered jamb stone with moulding profile, possible window/door jamb.  Jambs stones are an integral part of any window or door surround. They are the 'side pillars' that stretch from the cill to the head. Jambs are structural stones giving support the heads (or lintels) and also to the window frame which sits inside them. The chamfer on the stone measures 7cm wide and the 9cm deep.  A chamfer is a transitional, angled edge that replaces a sharp 90-degree corner between two faces of an object. Often created at a 45-degree angle. This stone is known locally as the ‘Woman’s Stone'.  Archaeological Survey of Ireland description at: https://tinyurl.com/Fahy-Church

name: Borneo orangutan (Pongo pygmaeus)
description:
The Orangutan of Borneo is a great ape native to the dense tropical forests of Borneo. It is one of the closest living relatives to humans and is known for its intelligence, long reddish-brown hair, and distinctive facial features.
The species was first scientifically described by the Italian naturalist Odoardo Beccari in the 19th century, following his explorations of Borneo’s rainforests. Bornean orangutans are primarily arboreal, spending most of their lives in trees, where they build nests for sleeping and travel through the canopy in search of fruits, leaves, and insects.
Pongo pygmaeus is critically endangered due to habitat loss, deforestation, and hunting. Conservation efforts focus on protecting forests, rescuing and rehabilitating individuals, and educating local communities.


This 3D model was created by Clarissa Bignoli and Erika Del Bene during their Universal Civil Service (SCU) at UniGe.

name: Energy Particle Stream
description:
In astrophysics, an energy particle stream typically refers to the solar wind or coronal mass ejections (CMEs), which are continuous or episodic flows of charged particles (electrons, protons, and helium nuclei) radiated from the Sun. 

These streams can interfere with satellite networks, impact ground-based power grids, and interact with planetary magnetic fields. 

High-velocity particle streams radiate from the Sun, often accompanied by solar flares and magnetic oscillations. 

As of 2025, solar activity is in a peak year of Cycle 25, resulting in frequent CMEs and intense particle stream events.

Large-scale energy streams, such as plasma jets from radio galaxies, can extend far beyond their host galaxies, dwarfing the size of the Milky Way.

In digital art and motion graphics, these streams are often depicted as vibrant, shimmering flows of kinetic energy, frequently using blue, green, or neon palettes to represent electricity and plasma.

name: Maiacetus innus  (skeleton cast)
description:
**Object: Model (cast) of *Maiacetus innus* skeleton from exhibition at the  Natural History Museum in Oslo**

Description: *Maiacetus innus*, a ~2.5 m-long Eocene archaeocete, represents an early stage in whale evolution. Its well-developed ankle bones, pelvic-vertebral connection, and shearing molars link it to terrestrial artiodactyl ancestors, while shortened limbs, elongated digits, and conical teeth reflect adaptations for life in water. *Maiacetus* is interpreted as a semiaquatic predator, spending most of its time hunting in aquatic habitats but returning to land to rest and give birth.

Type locality: Kunvit, Pakistan

Geology and Age:Habib Rahi Formation, early Lutetian stage of the middle Eocene,  approximately 47.5 Ma

Photogrametry model created by Maciej Ruciński using RealityCapture

**To read more visit our [blog ](https://norpal.wordpress.com/2024/08/02/maiacetus-a-key-piece-in-the-evolutionary-puzzle-of-whales/)**

name: Rüppell's fox
description:
3D scan of the skull of a Rüppell's fox (*Vulpes rueppellii*).


Rüppell's fox is a fox species living in desert and semi-desert regions of North Africa, the Middle East, and southwestern Asia. It is a small fox, measuring 66 to 74 cm in total length, including a tail measuring 27–30 cm long with an average weight of 1.7 kg. Rüppell's foxes occupy distinct territories, which they mark with urine, but not with dung as red foxes do. It has an omnivorous diet that varies considerably depending on what is locally available.

Specimen: Rüppell's fox, *Vulpes rueppellii* (Schinz, 1825)

Inventory number: C 1140

Collection: Natural History Museum University of Pisa 

Find out more about the Museum at https://www.msn.unipi.it/it/

Scanned and edited by Simone Farina

name: Tuberculosis Granulomatous in Liver
description:
This interactive 3D model demonstrates a granulomatous lesion within the liver by Tuberculosis , designed for educational purposes in pathology. for Veterinary medicine

The model allows a step-by-step visual exploration of the granuloma structure:

**Outer layer**: Fibrous connective tissue encapsulating the lesion
**Intermediate zone**: Aggregates of inflammatory cells (primarily macrophages and lymphocytes)
**Central core**: Caseation necrosis with areas of calcification, appearing as irregular, pale, cheese-like material

Users can freely navigate, zoom, and explore the internal architecture of the lesion, simulating a progressive microscopic examination from gross structure to cellular detail.

🎯 This model is ideal for:

Medical and pathology students
Visual learners
Interactive teaching and presentations
 
 MADE BY / Doha Essam aly

name: Lowpoly Basemeshes - 2026 - FBX
description:
My 2026 version of basemeshes of the human body. theres a simple body with the basic loops and the male and female bodies with more elaborated loops to fit the shape and volume of each gender anatomy. FBX.

Each body has its own rig and a couple poses within a single action in each skeleton/armature in order to display some extreme poses and check deformation of the loops.

The models are kinda lowpoly for today standards, making them a starting point to make humanoid characters and each model have a basic material with a basic 256px256px texture to display the loops. 

I was experimenting with extremes poses within a simple rig while i was making this, the overhaul topology is inspired by Dikkos 3D modeling videos like this one: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6ztn-S0o1DE&t=1230s

riging the pelvis and thighs were a nightmare for me this couple months, but i managed to find a solution on this video of Squeezy pixels: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GuPuXuDv56k   i have made a simplification of his solution.

name: Scipionyx samniticus ("Ciro")
description:
Il modello 3D rappresenta il calco dell'olotipo di Scipionyx samniticus ("Ciro"), primo dinosauro scoperto in Italia (Pietraroja, 113 mln di anni fa). L'originale, lungo 46 cm, è un pulcino di pochi giorni eccezionalmente conservato in 3D: preserva tessuti molli e organi interni unici, tra cui intestino con resti dell'ultimo pasto (pesci e lucertole), fegato, muscoli, trachea e guaine di cheratina. Bipede e predatore, appartiene ai Compsognathidae o a forme giovanili di grandi tetanuri. La presenza del sacco vitellino indica che era appena schiuso, offrendo dati inestimabili su fisiologia, respirazione e sviluppo dei teropodi mesozoici.

⚠️ Nota sulla demo: Scansione dimostrativa eseguita su un calco museale (non sull'originale) in condizioni di luce e ripresa sfavorevoli.

Seppur a bassa risoluzione, il modello è un utile risorsa didattica per scuole e appassionati per esplorare l'anatomia di questo fossile unico al mondo.

name: Museo y Archivo Histórico Municipal - Osorno
description:
Este modelo corresponde al **Museo y Archivo Histórico Municipal de Osorno**, el cual fue fundado en 1946 por Víctor Sánchez, director del Liceo de Hombres de Osorno, con apoyo de la Municipalidad. Su objetivo era conservar y exhibir reliquias donadas por familias de la zona. Tras funcionar en distintos lugares, en 1964 se trasladó a su ubicación actual en la calle Manuel Antonio Matta, en una antigua propiedad de la familia Schilling Bushmann.

*Este es un modelo con fines académicos de la asignatura Laboratorio Digital Multimedia del tercer semestre de la carrera Diseño Digital y Web de Inacap Osorno, dirigido por el docente Marco Barría. *

*Modelo creado por Melanie Andrade.*

name: Etnografinė sodyba / Ethnographic Homestead
description:
Skriaudžių buities muziejus

1987 m. trys pastatai - suvalkietiška dūminė stuba, kalvė ir mergaičių klėtelė buvo atvežti į Skriaudžius. Be to, prie jų buvo pastatyta dar viena klėtis, atvežta iš Janaukos kaimo gyventojo Kazio Rutkos sodybos. Muziejus prigludo prie Skriaudžių kanklių ansamblio įkūrėjo Prano Puskunigio sodybos. Lankytojams duris jis atvėrė 1989 m. 1991 m gegužės 14 d. Prienų rajono valdybos potvarkiu iki tol buvęs visuomeninis muziejus buvo perimtas savivaldybės žinion ir pavadintas Skriaudžių buities muziejumi. Didžioji eksponatų dalis, dabar esanti muziejuje, yra surinkta iš aplinkinių kaimų ir miestelių. Žmonės noriai atiduoda muziejui jiems jau atitarnavusius senus namų apyvokos daiktus, dokumentus, įrankius. Jie primena žmonių buitį prieš 100 ir daugiau metų, netolimos praeities kančias tremtyje, mažai apmokamus darbus kolūkiuose, amžinąją kovą ir tikėjimą savo tėvynės laisve.

Prienų krašto muziejus
Photogrammetry reconstruction in RealityCapture from 568 images. © Saulius Zaura

name: Sciuridae (ardilla)
description:
La ardilla es un pequeño mamífero conocido por su cuerpo ágil, su larga cola peluda y sus rápidos movimientos. Vive principalmente en los árboles, donde salta de rama en rama gracias a sus fuertes patas y garras afiladas. Su cola grande le sirve para mantener el equilibrio y abrigarse del frío.

Las ardillas se alimentan de nueces, semillas, frutos y, en ocasiones, pequeños insectos. Suelen guardar comida para el invierno, enterrándola en distintos lugares. Son animales muy curiosos y activos, especialmente durante el día. Además, desempeñan un papel importante en los bosques, ya que al enterrar semillas ayudan a que crezcan nuevos árboles.   
Este trabajo va dirigido para enseñar a los estudiantes de 9 grado de Educación General Básica Superior en la materia de Ciencias Naturales. 

El propósito es que los estudiantes sepan las principales características de este animal además de saber de donde proviene, de que se alimentan y cuál es su hábitat.

name: Kultura3D - Great Market Square in Zamość UNESCO
description:
The Great Market Square in Zamość.
Founded by Jan Zamoyski and designed by Bernardo Morando, this Renaissance city's urban layout draws on anthropomorphic concepts – the Zamoyski Palace symbolizes the head, Grodzka Street the spine, and the cross streets and bastions represent the city's arms, legs, and internal organs. Eight townhouses line all sides of the market square (except the northern one with the town hall), most of which bear names associated with their former owners and the buildings they housed. In 1922, on October 17, Józef Piłsudzki visited the Great Market Square, and a plaque commemorating this occasion was placed beneath the town hall. Preserved almost unchanged, Zamość is called the "pearl of the Renaissance" and is one of the most frequently visited cities in Eastern Poland.

Zonificación: División clara entre las líneas de producto con paneles gráficos informativos.

Iluminación: Cenefa superior con iluminación LED perimetral e interna para destacar el producto desde lejos y generar atracción visual.

Materialidad: Uso de texturas metálicas y acabados en "diamond plate" (suelo antideslizante) en la superficie de exhibición para reforzar la durabilidad y el carácter industrial de la marca.

name: Kultura3D - Zamoyski Palace in Zamość
description:
Zamoyski Palace in Zamość - a key element of the Renaissance ideal city, designed by Bernardo Morando in the late 16th century. Originally serving as the fortified castle of Chancellor Jan Zamoyski, it was rebuilt into a Baroque residence in the 18th century. In the years 1747–1751, the palace underwent a late Baroque renovation commissioned by Tomasz Antoni Zamoyski. After 1803, thanks to the 12th Ordynat Stanisław Kostka Zamoyski, the palace's style was changed to Classicism. Currently, a square with several trees has been established in front of the Zamoyski Palace, where since 2005 a monument of Jan Zamoyski, mounted on a horse and holding a baton in his right hand, has stood.

Located in the western part of the Old Town, on an east-west axis, the palace complex includes the palace, outbuildings, rear galleries, pavilions, and the former coach house.

The palace currently has a rectangular shape, retaining fragments of the original castle within its body.

The Starship Block 3 or V3/Version 3 introduces more upgrades like the Raptor 3 engines that produces more powerful thrust, capable to endure the heat without bulky head shielding and optimized for operational flights. Superheavy booster also have upgrades like 3 large gridfins over 4 stubby gridfins for more control authority & integrated hot staging that was attached permanently.

The second stage of Starship also have updates like the 4 ports are used for In Orbit Refueling. It also have RCS Systems like at the bottom for docking/deorbiting.

This model is 85% clean sheet and made from scratch while 15% of the parts were derived from my V1 Starship like Flaps, Rings, Stringers, and a Pez Dispenser.  This model introduces a mesh that is cleaner than the previous version that I have made in the past.

name: Tower-House Model E 32572 – Musée du Louvre
description:
Photogrammetric 3D model of tower-house model E 32572, Musée du Louvre, Paris.

The model was created as part of a research project on ancient Egyptian tower-house models and their potential as sources for the study of domestic architecture.

Object dimensions:
Height: 24.5 cm
Width: 8.4 cm
Depth: 8.5 cm

Photogrammetry:
295 photographs captured; 293 used for reconstruction.
66,248 tie points.
Point cloud: 3.67 million points.
Original photogrammetric mesh: 213,304 faces.

The model has been post-processed and optimised for online visualisation. This version is published for research dissemination and sharing; further optimisation of the textures and post-processing is still planned.

Data capture, photogrammetric processing and 3D post-processing by Alicia María Flores Martín.

name: Apsaras-Carved Pillar Crown (飞天石刻经幢盖)
description:
Dhvaja Pillar Crown with Flying Apsaras Carving is a 1,000-year-old stone artifact, now housed in Ningbo Museum. It was unearthed from the site of Tianning Temple. It measures approximately 30 cm in diameter and 20 cm in height; its surface features flying Apsaras (heavenly dancers in Buddhism) carved with vivid postures—robes flowing, hands making ritual gestures, and details like jewelry and clouds rendered with fine lines. Carved from hard stone, its smooth lines and lifelike Apsaras show the Song Dynasty’s advanced stone-carving skill. As a blend of Buddhist art and Chinese craft, it’s rare for its preservation and artistic expression, making it a key piece for studying Song-era religious art.

飞天石刻经幢盖是一件有 1000 年历史的石质文物，现藏于宁波博物院，出土于天宁寺遗址。直径约 30 厘米，高 20 厘米，表面雕刻飞天（佛教中的天女）形象，姿态灵动，衣带飘举，手势具仪式感，珠宝、云纹等细节以细密线条呈现。由坚硬石材雕刻而成，飞天线条流畅、形象逼真，展现宋代高超石刻技艺。作为佛教艺术与中国工艺的融合之作，其保存完整度与艺术表现力实属罕见，是研究宋代宗教艺术的重要实物。

name: Lost Stones of Strathtay - Craig Hill 2
description:
A small, ground level rock, seperated into two sub-panels by a central fracture.  This is CR2 in DES 2004.  

The rock is as recorded with the W sub-panel having all but one of the motifs.  The most prominent was described in DES 2004 as an oculus.  It is an oval-shaped ring containing two cup marks and 10 further cups grouped around it.  On the E sub-panel there is a single cup and ring mark.

This 3D photogrammetry modelling was compiled by Nick Parish in May 2026 on behalf of the Perth & Kinross Heritage Trust's , Lost Stones of Strathtay Project.

It may be best viewed using the Mattcap option in the Model Inspector.

name: Bovine Skull
description:
High-resolution 3D anatomical scan of a Bovine Skull (Bos taurus).

This digital model provides an accurate representation of the bovine cranial osteology, showcasing the complex structures of the splanchnocranium and neurocranium, including the frontal bones, cornual processes, orbital cavities, and dentition. It serves as a valuable resource for veterinary students, researchers, and digital artists requiring precise biological reference.

Source / Provenance: This specimen is part of the anatomical collection curated by Professor Antonio Palladino, Professor of Veterinary Anatomy, Histology, and Embryology at the University of Rome Tor Vergata (Università degli Studi di Roma Tor Vergata).

Suggested Use: Educational purposes, veterinary research, comparative anatomy study, and scientific visualization.

This model had its textures reduced from 4k to 2k to fit within the 100mbs limit. The topology is triangulated as it was sent to Unity 3D.

description: Modelo tridimensional do projeto estrutural de uma residência unifamiliar de 271,58 m², localizada em Florianópolis/SC. A estrutura, desenvolvida em concreto armado moldado in loco, distribui-se em três pavimentos — Térreo, Superior e Cobertura — e é composta por fundações em sapatas isoladas, pilares, vigas e lajes. As lajes são pré-moldadas treliçadas unidirecionais com blocos de enchimento em EPS e capa de concreto, enquanto as escadas, com 18 degraus e pé-direito de 3,06 m entre pavimentos, são em laje maciça. Foram adotados concreto C30 (fck 30 MPa) e aços CA-50 e CA-60, com dimensionamento conforme a ABNT NBR 6118:2024 e Classe de Agressividade Ambiental II (moderada). name: “The Marching Mother”
description:
This stylized polymer clay sculpture fuses cartoonish proportions with surreal detail, portraying a mouse-eared mother striding forward with tubular legs, clutching a crying child in one arm and a bottle in the other. The smooth, exaggerated forms evoke both pop-culture mascots and urban vinyl toys, while the hand-shaped contours preserve the warmth of its sculpted origin.

In a contemporary folktale, she is “The Marching Mother,” said to walk the endless streets of a city that never sleeps, calming restless children with stories whispered between the buildings. Some say her bottle contains not milk, but a potion that keeps nightmares away.

Originally crafted in polymer clay and scanned in high detail, this model is ideal as a narrative prop, collectible, or character element in stylized worlds.

O monumento é tombado pelas três instâncias de preservação: o IPHAN (Instituto do Patrimônio Histórico e Artístico Nacional), o CONDEPHAAT (Conselho de Defesa do Patrimônio Histórico, Arqueológico, Artístico e Turístico) e o CONPRESP (Conselho Municipal de Preservação do Patrimônio Histórico, Cultural e Ambiental da Cidade de São Paulo).   Construído originalmente em meados do século XVIII, o casarão é parte integrante das edificações que compõem o Museu da Cidade de São Paulo. É considerado o último exemplar remanescente de residência urbana de grande escala do período colonial no centro histórico de São Paulo construído em taipa de pilão. O modelo 3D foi desenvolvido no software Revit 2026, utilizando como base os desenhos técnicos em formato DWG fornecidos pela Secretaria Municipal de Cultura da Prefeitura de São Paulo modelado por Rafael Fernandes Dionizio. Modelo para fins ilustrativo.

name: Yarnaby - Poppy Playtime Chapter 4
description:
Yarnaby Wiki:

Yarnaby appears to be a lion-like monster covered in multicolored yarn acting as a sort of mane and fur-like covering all over the body. On his orange-yellow head, two strands of yarn are poking out, giving the yarn the impression of hair. His face consists of two large cartoony eyes with black irises and a big grin with three fangs poking out from his lower jaw. His split-lined face bisects to reveal a large, toothy, fleshy mouth with the two halves connected only by a small hole that leads to the throat and surrounded with more small jagged teeth. Yarnaby walks on all fours with orange-yellow legs with lighter coloured, three-toed paws; his Bigger Bodies form also has sharp bone white claws. Also in the artwork he has no claws.

This is a fan recreation designed by me xerxes3d for the VBunnyGo team for use as a VR avatar.

**This model is not downloable or for sale!**

name: アマオブネ /  Nerita albicilla
description:
和名の由来は、半卵形の貝殻を漁師が使う小舟に見立てたものである。殻の上面は黒と淡褐色のまだら模様が現れる。この模様は個体によって色帯や群雲模様になるなど変異がある。岩礁海岸の浅海に生息し、岩陰や転石の下に付着する。

The Japanese name comes from the fact that fishermen liken the semi-oval shell to a small boat. The upper surface of the shell has a mottled pattern of black and light brown. This pattern varies from individual to individual, with some having color bands or cloud-like patterns. It lives in shallow waters along rocky coastlines, attaching itself to rock shadows and under boulders.

name: アマオブネ /  Nerita albicilla
description:
和名の由来は、半卵形の貝殻を漁師が使う小舟に見立てたものである。殻の上面は黒と淡褐色のまだら模様が現れる。この模様は個体によって色帯や群雲模様になるなど変異がある。岩礁海岸の浅海に生息し、岩陰や転石の下に付着する。

The Japanese name comes from the fact that fishermen liken the semi-oval shell to a small boat. The upper surface of the shell has a mottled pattern of black and light brown. This pattern varies from individual to individual, with some having color bands or cloud-like patterns. It lives in shallow waters along rocky coastlines, attaching itself to rock shadows and under boulders.

和名：蜑小舟貝

英名：Nerita albicilla 

学名：*Nerita (Theliostyla) albicilla* Linnaeus,1758　
　　　  アマオブネガイ科　Neritidae

殻長：2㎝

name: Ceratosuchus skull cast
description:
From the Science Museum of Minnesota Paleontology Collection. No accession number (yet).
This is a plaster skull cast of a prehistoric crocodilian named Ceratosuchus. 

Due to the cast's uniform color and texture, Dr. Alex Hastings and I ripped up some dinosaur stickers--rip stickers--and put stickers on key areas of the cast so that the 3d modeling software would have an easier time finding landmarks and/or so I could manually allign the model if necessary. 

I kept the stickers in the texture because I think they are fun and they didn't cover anything morphologically significant.

This ancient crocodilian has little horns! I think they are cute.

name: スジウズラガイ / Oily Tun
description:
殻は薄質で、螺肋は低く、肋間にさらに細い二次肋がある。殻口の外唇内側に白い滑層がある。房総半島以南、熱帯インド-太平洋域の水深10～50ｍの細砂底。

The shell is thin-walled with low spiral ribs, and finer secondary ribs between the main ribs. A white lubricant layer is present on the inner side of the outer lip of the shell opening. Found south of the Boso Peninsula in the tropical Indo-Pacific region at depths of 10–50 m on fine sandy bottoms.

和名：筋鶉貝

英名：Oily Tun

学名：*Tonna olearium* (Linnaeus,1758)　ヤツシロガイ科　Tonnidae

殻長：15㎝

name: Piperstown Burial Cairn DU025-019001- Site K
description: Situated on the south-western facing slope of the Spink or Spinkeen (1,291 ft. / 393m OD), in the townland of Piperstown (Baile an Phiobaraigh), in the civil parish of Tallaght, in the barony of Uppercross, County Dublin.  A late-Neolithic / early Bronze Age (Chalcolithic) burial cairn known as Site K. Described by the excavators as; ‘Before excavation this site appeared as an irregular, low cairn of stones, measuring about 3.5–4m in diameter and about 50cm in maximum height.’ Excavations in 1962 revealed that the cairn was demarcated by six orthostats set at intervals around its perimeter. These varied from 0.43m to 0.58m in height and five of the six were inclined outwards, apparently pushed out by the weight of the cairn. Centrally set within the cairn was a circular, flat-bottomed pit which, though disturbed, contained a layer of charcoal and created bone at the bottom. Lying on the northern edge of the bone deposit was a small flake of whitish-grey flint'.  ASI entry at: https://tinyurl.com/Piperstown-K

name: Desert Goat (Ammotragus lervia)
description:
This voxel-based Desert/warm Goat is a stylized interpretation of the Barbary Sheep (Ammotragus lervia), a rugged mountain ungulate native to North Africa. With its distinctive curved horns, coarse sandy coat, and solid frame, the model captures the essence of a hardy desert grazer in a simplified, blocky aesthetic. Its compact geometry makes it ideal for educational exhibits, voxel wildlife collections, or game biomes inspired by arid highlands.

 
Taxonomy:

Kingdom: Animalia

Phylum: Chordata

Class: Mammalia

Order: Artiodactyla

Family: Bovidae

Genus: Ammotragus

Species: A. lervia


The Desert/warm Goat (Barbary Sheep) is native to rocky mountains and dry plateaus of North Africa, particularly in regions of Morocco, Algeria, and Chad. It thrives in arid and semi-arid environments, navigating steep cliffs and feeding on sparse grasses and shrubs. Introduced populations also exist in parts of Texas and Spain, where they adapt well to warm, rugged habitats.

name: BRAKE CALLIPER
description:
A brake caliper is a crucial component of a disc braking system, typically used in modern vehicles. It houses the brake pads and pistons and plays a key role in slowing or stopping a vehicle by creating friction against the brake rotor.

Function:

The caliper works by applying hydraulic pressure from the braking system to the brake pads. When the driver presses the brake pedal, brake fluid is forced into the caliper, pushing the pistons outward. This causes the brake pads to clamp onto the rotating brake disc (rotor), generating friction that slows the wheel's rotation and ultimately brings the vehicle to a stop.

YOUTUBE VIDEO LINK : https://youtu.be/iFXA968Rjg4

name: Museo Guggenheim de Bilbao
description:
El Museo Guggenheim Bilbao es un museo de arte contemporáneo diseñado por el arquitecto canadiense Frank O. Gehry y localizado en Bilbao (País Vasco), España. Es uno de los museos vinculados en régimen de franquicia o colaboración con la Fundación Solomon R. Guggenheim. Fue inaugurado el 18 de octubre de 1997 por el rey Juan Carlos I de España.

Es de estilo Desconstructivista y se considera una excepción a la regla de todo diseño arquitectónico, al punto que hoy se conoce el llamado efecto Bilbao por lograr que la ciudad de Bilbao en España, casi desconocida, más que por su economía basada en la pesca local y sus quesos de exportación, se convirtión en todo un centro del arte y la cultura internacional, llevando miles de turistas al año y generando millones de euros por este nuevo modelo de economía nacional.

Para aprender más sobre este tema, visita nuesto video sobre el Desconstructivismo en Youtube, canal Analízate Esto: https://youtu.be/TYyaB1gFVe8?si=6TGP7z1F3IHZuN1n

Este modelo fue creado con IA.

В селе Лор Сюникской области Армении находится церковь Сурб Ованес (Святого Иоанна Крестителя).  Церковь датируется 1658 годом. Она была построена на месте более древнего храма. Храм представляет собой трехнефную базилику. Здание сложено из базальта. Село Лор является родиной знаменитого армянского поэта Амо Сагияна (1914–1993). Рядом с церковью находится кладбище с древними хачкарами и надгробиями.
Սյունիքի մարզի Լոր գյուղի Սուրբ Հովհաննես եկեղեցին 17-րդ դարի հոգևոր կառույց է, որը հանդիսանում է տարածաշրջանի կարևոր պատմամշակութային արժեքներից մեկը: 
Եկեղեցին կառուցվել է 1658 թվականին: Այն իրենից ներկայացնում է եռանավ բազիլիկ կառույց: Տարիներ շարունակ խարխուլ վիճակում գտնվելուց հետո, եկեղեցին ենթարկվել է հիմնավոր վերականգնման: 2025 թվականի մայիսի 10-ին տեղի է ունեցել եկեղեցու հանդիսավոր վերաօծման արարողությունը՝ ձեռամբ Սյունյաց թեմի առաջնորդ Տեր Մակար եպիսկոպոս Հակոբյանի:

name: Christmas Lights
description:
This asset is a customizable curve-driven LED ornament made with Geometry Nodes (Blender).

You can easily edit the curve to change the shape of the light strip or create a completely new curve and apply the same geometry node system.

The light colors are fully adjustable, allowing you to create endless variations (warm white, cold white, blue, etc.) to match any scene or holiday style.

For better visualisation, I recommend activating the glare filter in the compositing tab and activating the composition view in the layout.

Perfect for Christmas scenes, festive environments, street decorations, or glowing ornamental details.



**Full project available on Fab:**
https://www.fab.com/es-es/sellers/Santi.3D

**Also on Turbosquid, CGTrader, Blenderkit and Gumroad**, links here: https://linktr.ee/santi3D

name: 141 Neil Road NUS Arclab
description: Step inside one of Singapore’s hidden architectural treasures. Built in the early 1880s, 141 Neil Road is a beautifully conserved townhouse that showcases the evolution of Singapore’s urban heritage. Blending the First Transitional style with intricate decorative reliefs, a traditional Pintu Pagar entrance gate, and elegant Art Nouveau-inspired interiors, the building tells the story of the city’s rich cultural and architectural history. Now home to the National University of Singapore’s Architectural Conservation Laboratory (ArClab), it continues to inspire research, education, and heritage conservation. This 3D model digitally preserves the building’s unique architectural character, allowing viewers to explore its details and craftsmanship from anywhere in the world.

name: Lamborghini Countach - LP 5000 S
description:
To be honest, the Lamborghini Countach was never my 'dream car' as a child. What made me create this car was the fact that it reminded me of playing with my friend and his Hot Wheels Countach that he found on the street (Yes! this is crazy, what a luck kid). Recently, he found that toy again and sent me a picture, so I took advantage of that nostalgic moment to create this model. This 3D model (white with stripes) was inspired by that Hot Wheels.

I came across many different versions of the Lamborghini, and things started to get a little more complicated. The roof was different in many photos, the rear hood had several versions, and some details changed depending on the region. I’m happy with the result. I mainly relied on photos I found online, so I know it's far from perfect, especially in terms of scaling, but I believe I captured the essence of the car with my current skills.

name: Relief Cathedral of Santiago de Compostela (3)
description: This model belongs to a pair of figures located on the wall of the Cathedral of Santiago de Compostela, attached to the wall in a side area as part of the late Romanesque sculptural program. They are sculptures reused from the old choir of Master Mateo, currently embedded in the exterior south wall, to the right of the Puerta de las Platerías. When Master Mateo’s choir was dismantled in the 17th century, most of its sculptures were dispersed. Several were placed along this section of the south wall, where they remain today, aligned or embedded as part of the exterior decoration. This model was photogrammetrically recorded by Artmonite during a visit to Santiago de Compostela in 2025. Download this model from: https://artmonite.com/en/product/relieve-catedral-santiago-de-compostela-3/

name: 2024 Ferrari 499P
description:
The Ferrari 499P is a sports prototype built by Scuderia Ferrari to compete in the FIA World Endurance Championship in the Le Mans Hypercar category since 2023. The introduction of the 499P marks 50 years since Ferrari last fielded a factory-backed sports prototype that contested for the overall win at the 24 Hours of Le Mans, and one of the 499Ps raced with the number 50 as a tribute.

The car was unveiled in October 2022 at the Ferrari Finali Mondiali, Ferrari's annual finale for their one-make series, Ferrari Challenge. The car made its competitive debut at the season-opening round of the 2023 FIA World Endurance Championship, the 2023 1000 Miles of Sebring. On its first outing at the 2023 24 Hours of Le Mans, the 499P driven by Antonio Giovinazzi, Alessandro Pier Guidi, and James Calado won the race.

![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/d/d7/2023_6_Hours_of_Spa-Francorchamps_Ferrari_AF_Corse_Ferrari_499P_No.50_%28DSC09253%29.jpg)\

Credits to: @heynic and @MattDoesBlender

description:
This model uses a clean, top-down (orthographic) vector style divided into three distinct, color-coded zones connected by a central green space:

    The Academic Core (North): Features sleek, slate-gray building footprints for Science, Tech, and the Humanities, anchored by a large, circular Library icon.

    Student Life Hub (Center): Features the Student Union and Admin buildings, opening up to a vibrant green Central Quad detailed with benches, fountains, and trees.

    Residential & Athletics (South/West): Includes modular blocks for the Dormitories and an oval running track/field for the Sports Complex.

    UI/Map Key: Includes interactive, pulsing pins over each building that users can click to view department info, operating hours, and indoor floor plans.

name: Dilophosaurus Wetherilli (Jungle skin)
description:
Most well-known for being the exotic frilled spitter in a popular dinosaur franchise, the **Dilophosaurus** is certainly an exotic beauty in real life. Although the frill and the venom spitting aren't a real part of the animal, it is still an amazing predator, larger than its appearance on-screen. Here, the creature model is reconstructed with our up-to-date understanding of the creature.

The model is a **Production-Ready Rig**, which includes advanced controls for efficient posing and animations, IKs and FKs, bone chains, a Custom UI panel (only available for Blender versions 4.2+), model shape key variations, and custom bone properties.

This model features a **FREE** version. A low-poly mesh, with 2 textures, and a basic rig. Available on **GUMROAD**.

name: Dilophosaurus Wetherilli (Jungle skin)
description:
Most well-known for being the exotic frilled spitter in a popular dinosaur franchise, the **Dilophosaurus** is certainly an exotic beauty in real life. Although the frill and the venom spitting aren't a real part of the animal, it is still an amazing predator, larger than its appearance on-screen. Here, the creature model is reconstructed with our up-to-date understanding of the creature.

The model is a **Production-Ready Rig**, which includes advanced controls for efficient posing and animations, IKs and FKs, bone chains, a Custom UI panel (only available for Blender versions 4.2+), model shape key variations, and custom bone properties.

This model features a **FREE** version. A low-poly mesh, with 2 textures, and a basic rig. Available on **GUMROAD**.

name: old shrine
description:
Hidden within desolate, mist-shrouded mountains, this undocumented shrine exists only on the fringes of reality.

The entrance is marked by a weathered torii gate, its surface textured like dried blood. Passing through it instantly severs all natural sounds, plunging visitors into a suffocating, unnatural silence. The path leads to a dark, heavy timber worship hall lined with lattice windows. The pitch-black interior creates an eerie sensation of unseen eyes staring back, while a bottomless offertory box is placed at the center, containing nothing but a dark abyss.

Local legend warns that the forgotten, wrathful deity enshrined here can grant any desire—even a curse—but those who make a wish must never look back upon leaving. It is said that at midnight, the wind blowing through the structure sounds like frantic, hidden whispers calling out your name.

The Monte Carlo Rally or Rallye Monte-Carlo (officially Rallye Automobile Monte-Carlo) is a rallying event organized each year by the Automobile Club de Monaco.

From its inception in 1911 by Prince Albert I, the rally was intended to demonstrate improvements and innovations in automobiles, and promote Monaco as a tourist resort on the Mediterranean shore. Before the format changed in 1997, the event was a “concentration rally” in which competitors would set off from various starting points around Europe and drive to Monaco, where the rally would continue to a set of special stages.

The rally now takes place along the hills of the French Riviera and southeast France (Provence-Alpes-Côte d'Azur and the southern parts of Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes). In 2026, for the first time since the 2008 Monte Carlo Rally, the event returned to within the borders of Monaco for a Super Special Stage.

name: Tower-House Model EA 2462 – British Museum
description:
Photogrammetric 3D model of tower-house model EA 2462, British Museum, London.

The model was created as part of a research project on ancient Egyptian tower-house models and their potential as sources for the study of domestic architecture.

Object dimensions:
Height: 21 cm
Width: 11 cm
Depth: 9.5 cm

Photogrammetry:
466 photographs captured; 332 selected and imported for processing; all 332 aligned for reconstruction.
115,899 tie points.
Point cloud: 5.54 million points.
Original photogrammetric mesh: 443,350 faces.

The model has been post-processed and optimised for online visualisation. This version represents the completed post-processing workflow for online dissemination, although further refinement remains possible.

Data capture, photogrammetric processing and 3D post-processing by Alicia María Flores Martín.

name: LMS Fowler 3F 'Jinty' Locomotive
description:
The Class 3F or 'Jinty' was a small steam locomotive built by the London, Midland and Scottish Railways between 1924 and 1931 and were used for various shunting, freight and small passenger services. They were so popular and versatile that a total of 422 were built and used across the UK until 1967.

This was a high-poly model that I had created a couple of years ago however was never fully happy with the texturing I had done for it. I decided to return to this and give texturing it another go, especially keen to use it for practicing my weathering techniques. Overall I'm really happy with how these turned out and renders can be found here: https://www.artstation.com/artwork/a0J3P0

Modelled in Maya, textured in Substance Painter and Krita.

Is e structar fo-thalamh bho Linn an Iarainn a th’ ann an Taigh-làir (no Taigh Talmhainn) Rennibister air tìr-mòr Arcaibh. Le coltas gun deach a thogail sa chiad mhìle-bliadhna BC, tha e air a dhèanamh suas de thrannsa aomaichte a tha a’ leantainn gu seòmar ugh-chruthach a bhiodh aig aon àm mar phàirt de thuineachadh nas motha.

Dh’fhaodadh gun robh e air a chleachdadh sa chiad àite mar àite stòraidh ach is dòcha gun robh airson gnìomhan eile cuideachd, a’ gabhail a-steach chleachdaidhean deas-ghnàthach. Gu h-inntinneach, anns an tasgadh dùnaidh bha cnàmhlaich measgaichte de suas ri 18 neach, a’ gabhail a-steach 12 chloinne.

Air a lorg ann an 1926 nuair a thuit am mullach a-steach fo chuideam inneal bualaidh, chaidh an seòmar fo-thalamh a chladhach le Comann Arc-eòlais Arcaibh, fo stiùir Ùistean Marwick. Gu làithreach, tha e suidhichte taobh a-staigh iolthainn obrach Tuathanas Rennibister, le slighe a-steach don t-seòmar a-nis tron mhullach, le haitse ùr agus àradh.

name: コトショクコウラ /  Harpa articularis
description:
その美しい色彩と艶が特徴で、貝殻コレクターに人気がある。卵形で周縁は丸く膨らむ。肩の棘は弱い。殻口軸唇は黒褐色で腹面を広く覆う。奄美諸島以南、熱帯西太平洋の水深5～30ｍの砂底。

Characterized by its beautiful colors and luster, it is popular among shell collectors. It is ovoid with a rounded, bulging margin. The shoulder spines are weak. The umbo and labium are dark brown, broadly covering the ventral surface. Found south of the Amami Islands in the tropical western Pacific Ocean at depths of 5 to 30 meters on sandy bottoms.

和名：コトショクコウラ

英名：Harpa articularis

学名：Harpa articularis Lamarck,1816　ショクコウラ科　Harpidae

殻長：8㎝

参考文献：「日本近海産貝類図鑑」【第二版】奥谷喬司 編著 東海大学出版部（2017年1月）

References：Illustrated Guide to Shellfish of Japanese Coastal Waters [Second Edition] Edited by Takashi Okutani Tokai University Press (January 2017)

name: Lintel: Haragauri (Shiva & Gauri or Parvati)
description:
**8th-century** Pratihara stone lintel (lalatabimba) from Abhaneri, Rajasthan 
(Acc. No. 69.133, National Museum, New Delhi). 

Originally positioned as the central upper beam of a temple sanctum (garbhagriha) doorway, this piece framed the sacred entrance and designated the primary deity inside.

The central scene depicts Haragauri **(Shiva and Parvati)** in an intimate seated posture (alingana-murti). Shiva holds traditional attributes like the tridents/damaru while Parvati rests beside him, flanked by celestial figures (vidyadharas) and attendants along the relief.

Characteristic of Gurjara-Pratihara art, it displays fluid body postures (bhanga), intricate crowns (mukuta), and deeply undercut details. Pre-photogrammetry reconstruction of 8th-century Indian heritage architecture.

Dimensions: 39 x 156 x 28 cm.

name: Tortoise
description:
It's a tortoise I made in 3D Coat, as an exercise to learn the software. Usually I use Blender. I really enjoyed 3DCoat, especially the voxel sculpting and the painting. I liked how easy it was to move back and forth from sculpt to paint, and from voxel to surface/multires. I didn't love the retopology tools, mostly because I can already retopologize things in Blender... but I'll definitely use them again for less difficult assets. The UV tools were fast and almost effortless to use.

The tortoise is mostly based on various Galapagos Giant Tortoise pictures I found, but I also took some liberties. The goal was to make it realistic without spending more than 3 days learning the software (Sculpt, paint, retopologize, UV unwrap, bake/export). In the end, I spent the 3 days, thought about it a bit, and used another half day to improve the texture (a lot!) with the knowledge I gained during the first pass. I did the rig/walk-cycle in Blender.

name: Rescue Excavations at the Mère de Dieu School
description:
**Rescue Excavations at the Mère de Dieu School, Alexandria, Egypt**

This 3D model documents an archaeological rescue excavation at the Mère de Dieu School site in Alexandria, Egypt, revealing an important extension of the ancient city dating to the 5th century CE.

The excavation uncovered a well-preserved section of the ancient vertical street **R3 bis**, identified according to the plan of Mahmoud Bey El-Falaki. The street is paved with white dolomite blocks and represents a rare in situ example of Alexandria’s Late Antique urban network.

Along both sides of the street, remains of original structures were found, including foundations of shops, houses, and a possible Roman **thermopolium (taberna)** for food preparation and sale.

Finds include gypsum and painted clay figurines, stamped amphora handles, terracotta seal impressions, pottery, oil lamps, bronze coins, part of an alabaster statue of Serapis, wells, water-lifting installations, and mosaic floor remains.

name: Clay Standing Bodhisattva Statue (彩绘木胎泥塑菩萨立像)
description:
The Painted Wooden-core Clay Standing Bodhisattva Statue of the Northern Song Dynasty is the treasure of Wenzhou Museum. With a fir framework, it is modeled with yellow clay mixed with hemp fibers and chaff, refined with fine white clay, and decorated with mineral pigments and gold painting. It is a masterpiece of Wenzhou Ou Sculpture and Song Dynasty painted sculpture. The statue features a delicate and gentle face, a slender and elegant posture, a high chignon with a gorgeous crown, hanging silk scarves, a necklace of precious ornaments, and smooth clothing lines. Standing barefoot on a lotus pedestal with a serene and compassionate expression, it fully presents the high secularization of Buddhist statues in the Song Dynasty and the aesthetic characteristics of the Jiangnan region, known as the "Oriental Venus" of Wenzhou。

北宋彩绘木胎泥塑菩萨立像是温州博物馆的镇馆之宝。此像以杉木为骨，外敷掺麻丝、谷壳的黄泥塑形，再以细白泥精修，经矿物彩绘与描金而成，是瓯塑与宋代彩塑的巅峰之作。造像面容秀丽温婉，体态修长优雅，高髻华冠、宝缯垂肩，胸佩璎珞、衣纹流畅，跣足立于仰莲座，神情静谧慈悲，尽显宋代佛教造像高度世俗化与江南审美特质，被誉为温州的 “东方维纳斯”。

name: ImagineFun Train - The "Carlin"
description: As of right now, this is one of the many models over the years that's gone unused on the ImagineFun Minecraft server. Nonetheless, it's one of my all time favorites. Obviously this isn't in my usual voxel cube 3D style, but rather a more stylized approach that's more commonly found around the Minecraft space nowadays. This is my first real attempt at that style, and really the only one. If I'd had my way with it, it'd be running around the hub world of the server right now! The locomotive is named after George Carlin, the narrator of the Thomas and Friends TV series that I grew up with and one of my all time favorite comedians. I was hoping to make a couple of additional locomotives (really just re-skins of this one) named after Ringo Starr and Alec Baldwin, but alas. I also wanted at least one diesel, though I'm not sure what I would've ended up naming her...

The model was developed with attention to the character's recognizable silhouette, proportions, clothing, and overall appearance. The project also served as an opportunity to explore and improve different stages of the 3D character production process.

WORKFLOW
Modeling — Blender
UV Unwrapping — Blender
Rigging — Blender / Rigify
Hand Paint Texturing — Substance Painter

TECHNICAL DETAILS
Faces: 9739

description:
Title

Cui Jue | Judge of the Underworld

Description

Inspired by Chinese underworld mythology, this collectible statue depicts Cui Jue (崔珏), one of the most respected judges of the Netherworld. Known for recording mortal deeds and assisting the rulers of the underworld, Cui Jue serves as a symbol of justice, karma, and the balance between virtue and sin.

Clad in traditional magistrate robes and carrying the authority of the underworld courts, he stands as an eternal witness to the fate of every soul. His presence reflects the solemn duty of judging the dead and preserving the cosmic order beyond mortal life.

The intricate robes, ceremonial accessories, and underworld symbolism blend traditional folklore with a dark fantasy collectible statue aesthetic.

Inscription

Hi, Little Ones!

I finished my version of The Ferryman and thought I should share it. Before you download and use this model, there are a few things I wanted to say.

Firstly, this is my first time sculpting, retopologizing, and texturing, so there might be some questionable choices here and there.

Also, it’s not ready for animation right away. I originally wanted to use Mixamo for rigging The Ferryman, but I ran into an error I couldn’t figure out, so I ended up painting the weights myself. Since I didn’t have enough time, I just made sure it would work for rendered images. If you’d like, you can repaint the weights and use it for animation!

name: 北京碧雲寺羅漢堂No.444破邪見尊者
description:
**濠江陳生數字造像發願文**

蓋聞慧燈西照，法流東漸；聖道多元，同歸慈憫。自金人入夢，玉像垂祥，鑄石鐫金，無非為眾生植福；丹青土木，皆是以至誠通神。今有濠江陳氏子，感念浮生易逝，親恩難酬，乃效古德遺風，虔發宏願。竊以祖德綿長，厚澤深而庭梧茂；親恩劬勞，春暉暖而萱室寧。 更幸雙珠耀彩，明慧天成；淑儷同心，蘭薰玉潤。然世路多虞，時疫頻仍，觀寰宇之動盪，惕息無常。遂發心以數字為斧斤，以虛明為金銅，摹刻諸聖妙容，供養無邊刹土。乃廣采華夏之粹，旁搜寰宇之英：釋教有佛陀菩薩之悲容，道門存天尊真人之逸韻，乃至天主聖徒，昭示博愛之光。藉今世科技之利，融三代匠作之魂，以點線為骨，以光影為色，鑄三維法身於虛擬淨土，樹數字蓮座於雲端梵刹。雖非金石不朽，然願智慧網路，傳之彌廣；法相莊嚴，見者生敬。

伏願：
**一願堂上雙親，松柏增齡，安康永駐，無煩無惱，安樂怡年。
二願祖輩高慈，壽考維祺，德昭後裔；孫枝競秀，喜樂長伴，福蔭滿庭。
三願闔家眷屬，災障冰消，吉曜常臨，出入光亨，萬事和順。
四願膝下明珠，雙耀吾門：長幼康寧，永葆椿萱之茂；慧心玲瓏，常開棠棣之芳。芝蘭並秀，喜樂恒昌。
五願見聞隨喜者，共沐慈輝，同沾法益，啟一念之善心，種未來之福田。
六願寰宇眾生，戾氣消散，干戈永息，各遂其所，共樂升平。**

更祈：
數字法流，遍周沙界；一點靈光，皆作舟筏。使古德之悲願，得傳於光纖電波；令方寸之虔誠，可抵乎四海八荒。芥子納須彌，虛擬非虛；圖元聚寶相，真心即真。

時維
二零二六年佛誕日吉辰
功德主濠江陳氏沐手謹志並恭制

銘曰：
非金非石，無罣無礙
慧光所攝，遍滿大千
一燈燃而千燈續
此心通處即靈山

Grave slab measures at least 1.57 m long  (W–E) and up to 0.45 m wide, although its W end not fully exposed due to presence of a leaning headstone. The slab has near-parallel sides, in places slightly flaked, and rounded corners. It slopes slightly to the N, where it abuts another slab (BGCP_58).

There is an inscription, possibly a later addition to an earlier slab, slightly S of centre, 0.56 m from the head of the slab, with letters 70 mm tall:
**P F**

name: Свисток керамічний
description: Свисток керамічний у формі пташки, виготовлений ручним способом зі світлої глини з подальшим випалом. Виріб має стилізовані обриси з розширеним округлим тулубом, витягнутим хвостовим мундштуком та масивною конічною ніжкою-підставкою. Всередині - звукова камера із трьома отворами. Поверхня природнього світло-вохристого відтінку із нерівномірним червоно-коричневим напиленням. На бічних сторонах тулуба збереглися фрагменти розпису у вигляді темно-сірих і синяво-чорних круглих плям. Фізичний стан експонату оцінюється як незадовільний через численні механічні пошкодження. Верхня частина виробу втрачена внаслідок відламу голівки пташки, у місці відламу відкрито внутрішній простір камери. На основі підставки, в зоні зламу та по всій поверхні черепка спостерігаються глибокі сколи, сітка дрібних тріщин, стирання фарбованого шару та сліди поверхневої ерозії глиняної маси.

name: Golden Incense Altar | Astrogeomanity
description:
A 3D reconstruction of the Golden Incense Altar, inspired by the sacred furnishings of the Tabernacle and the First Temple of Jerusalem.
Crafted from acacia wood and overlaid with pure gold, the altar was used for burning fragrant incense — a symbol of prayer, purification, and the connection between humanity and the Divine.

This digital re-creation is part of the Astrogeomanity Project, uniting biblical heritage, sacred geometry, and modern 3D design.
Created and curated by Eng. Daniel Grossman Nehemya for the Astrogeomanity Virtual Museum, preserving the spirit of ancient craftsmanship through technological artistry.

🜂 Modeled in Blender & TinkerCAD
🜄 Represents the symbolism of light, scent, and devotion
🜁 Optimized for VR and educational exhibitions
🜃 Part of the Astrogeomanity Biblical Heritage Collection

A stylized, horizontal wavy decorative band acts as a symbolic handle wrapped around its upper rim. Such vessels were highly valued across early Nile communities and typically placed in tombs to store oils, wine, or food for the deceased in the afterlife.

Catalogue Information: AS090

Model of the Robert Kerr located north of Thetis Island near Ladysmith, BC, Canada. The remains of the Robert Kerr, a converted Barque that sunk in 1911, are surprisingly intact and still identifiable considering how long she has been under 13 m of water.

The model was generated with photogrammetry software 3DF Zephyr v8.017 processing 4997 images out of 5006. The images were taken using a DPV mounted sled with 2 Gopro 11 cameras and 4 Bigblue lights.

A big thank you to my teamates: Jason Cook, Tom Crisp and Chris Knoblauch and Guy Shockey from Thermocline Diving.

The Dombra is a traditional Kazakh musical instrument, deeply rooted in the culture and heritage of Kazakhstan. It is a long-necked, two-stringed lute, usually made of wood, and played by plucking the strings with fingers. name: The Argo-Beachrock Project
description:
The Argo-Beachrock Project: Web mapping and geovisualisation of beachrocks using UAS along the coast of the Argolic Gulf in the eastern Peloponnese (Greece). Applying a methodological approach to survey the nearshore zone, record ancient lithified beaches, and decode the relative sea level changes during the Late Holocene, based on their bathymetry and dating. Beachrocks contribute to mitigating the effects of coastal erosion and developing effective coastal adaptation strategies.
The action is implemented with the support of the AC Laskaridis Charitable Foundation in the framework of "Points of Support", a co-funded programme by 10 public benefit foundations.

name: Osmundtunna 6 / Osmund Barrel

There is about 100 barrels, in good condition, filled with osmund iron which is unique.
Other finds of single barrels are in worse shape and heavily corroded:

2 Gdansk

Osmundar är ett handelsjärn använt under medeltid och tidigmodern tid. Uppdelat i bitar om ca: 200-400g. Bitarna består av färskat tackjärn (framställt i masugn).

name: New Balance 2002R Protection Pack Phantom Black
description:
2002R Phantom. Pushing the quality of materials and resolution of the mesh, this shoe hits a level of realism that does justice to the original design by New Balance. The suede and fabric mesh surfaces were the main focus, built on top of a sharp sole that blends hard plastic and soft foam. Details of the shoe remain physical, from the hairy suede to the stitching of logos, This approach allows for a greater depth in renders and helps to bring these details to life. 

**Technical Details**
With most details being physical, the polycount of the mesh is very high, 4.2 million vertices. The suede and mesh fabric account for most of these polys (~65%). The shoe is comprised of eight 4k texture sets which use Base Color, Metallic, Roughness, Normal, and Opacity. These texures are set up using a UDIM workflow, contact me if you need them sepearated (or for any questions you may have) 

For the **Optimised Version**, I created a 3d scan from high res renders of the mesh, this can be previewed here:

name: Tavolino Minimal
description:
tavolino minimal con struttura metallica e piano a specchio.
Struttura composta da due gambe cilindriche in acciaio nero, impostate lungo l’asse X. I cilindri hanno sezione ellittica deformata: diametro maggiore lungo X e ridotto lungo Y, creando una forma allungata e schiacciata lateralmente. Le gambe sono posizionate in modo simmetrico rispetto al centro del tavolo e sostengono direttamente il piano superiore senza elementi intermedi visibili.
Il piano del tavolo è una lastra sottile e rettangolare, con superficie altamente riflettente tipo specchio. Il materiale è un metallo lucidato o vetro specchiato, con roughness quasi nulla e metallic elevato, in modo da generare riflessioni nette dell’ambiente circostante.
L’insieme è essenziale, geometrico e bilanciato, con forte contrasto tra la massa visiva delle gambe nere opache e la superficie superiore riflettente. Il risultato è un oggetto di design minimale con impronta industriale e contemporanea.

name: Cráneo de Gigantosauro
description:
Cráneo de Gigantosauro incluido en la exposición temporal *Dinosaurios de la Patagonia*, que se puede admirar en las instalaciones de Cosmocaixa, antiguo Museo de la Ciencia, Barcelona. 
Modelo fotogramétrico optimizado, elaborado con 77 imágenes.
El *Giganotosaurus carolinii* es la única especie conocida del género extinto *Giganotosaurus*. Se trata de un dinosaurio terópodo carcarodontosáurido, que vivió a mediados del periodo Cretácico hace aproximadamente entre 99,6 y 96 millones de años, en el Cenomaniense, en lo que hoy es Sudamérica. Es uno de los mayores terópodos conocidos; se cree que alcanzaba longitudes de entre 12,3 y 13,2 metros, con un cráneo de posiblemente de más de 1,60 metros de largo y un peso aproximado de entre 7 y 8 toneladas.
Debió ser el depredador más grande de su época, ubicándose en la cima de la cadena alimenticia.

![https://assets2.fossilera.com/p/1113/600x%3E/Giganotosaurus-with-scale.jpg](https://assets2.fossilera.com/p/1113/600x%3E/Giganotosaurus-with-scale.jpg)

Паутинник фиолетовый (лат. Cortinarius violaceus) — гриб из рода Паутинник семейства Паутинниковые (Cortinariaceae). Занесён в Красную книгу России и Республики Башкортостан. Встречается в лиственных и смешанных лесах, образует микоризу с берёзой, осиной, тополем. Считается съедобным грибом 4ой категории.

Cortinarius violaceus is a fungus from the genus of spider web in the family Cortinariaceae. It is listed in the Red Book of Russia and the Republic of Bashkortostan. It is found in deciduous and mixed forests, forms mycorrhiza with birch, aspen, poplar. It is considered an edible mushroom of the 4th category.

name: StarSeeds
description:
Plants that catalyze water into rocket fuel?? It's more likely than you think!
H2O ----->   Hydrogen + Oxygen + Spark = Thrust!

This selection of valuable plants is en route to an Anastos manufactory, where each plant pod will become a key module in a recon probe, supplying the probe with a somewhat renewable source of fuel provided it dips into high atmo every now and then to refill its water tanks. 

I made this project to challenge my speed modeling, I had 30 mins to create reference for the project and I was able to complete the model in 4 hours and 27 minutes. 
I took my time with the texturing because I find the process methodical and relaxing at times, but perhaps I should try a speed texturing exercise sometime.
I kept the polys real low this time, I know a lot of people don't like how faceting looks but honestly its kind of charming to me these days. Lmk what you think.



I do not consent to this model in whole or in part being used to train generative AI platforms.

name: Moon halo over La Silla, Chile
description:
ESO 3.6-metre telescope in Chile illuminated by moonlight. The whole observatory contains many telescopes located on a mountain resembling a saddle (Sp.: la Silla).

Jupiter is in Leo. The Moon between Orion and Gemini. The Sun (invisible after the sunset) somewere in Pisces. The date must be 11 April 2016.

The original picture:
https://www.eso.org/public/images/nik7687p4-cc-extended/

No sundogs (here called paraselenae). It means no regular plates. Such plates usually fall positioned horizontally.

No Lowitz arcs, so  no elongated plates either. Such plates constantly rotate having  four edges horizontal.   

No tangent arcs nor circumscribed halo . Thus no horizontal columns.  

No Parry arcs.  I means there are no columns in their most restricted position - with one side lying flat as on a table. 

No 46 halo. I do not know why.

Conclusion:
Crystals creating the halo  are highly irregular, for example joined plates, joined columns and so on. They fall in a random way.

Credit:
ESO/B. Tafreshi

name: Acetylcholinesterase (AChE) and Aricept (E2020)
description:
Acetylcholinesterase (AChE) is a serine hydrolase that has one of the fasted known turnover rates. It stops the transmission of nerve signals by breaking down acetylcholine (ACh) into choline and acetate at synapses between nerve and muscle cells using a serine-histidine-glutamate/aspartate catalytic triad, forming a short-lived acyl-enzyme intermediate that is quickly hydrolyzed.

Alzheimer’s disease is associated with a deficient in cholinergic transmission (release of Ach to signal other cells) so AChE inhibitors are used to increase ACh levels and manage cognitive symptoms.

Aricept is a leading, reversible, non-covalent AChE inhibitor that slows the enzyme’s ability to hydrolyze ACh. 
In this tour we will explore how Aricept spans the gorge of the Pacific electric ray AChE and take a look at the important interactions that stabilize its binding.

name: Orbitals part 2
description:
In part 1 I did not mention that according to classical physics electrons moving on curved lines, accelerating or slowing down should send electromagnetic waves and finally fall onto the nucleus. For an unknown reason usually they do not produce the waves. 

We obtained a Ne atom. Present quantum physics give more details, yet some difficult to accept. 
Models:

1.  The first electron moves around the nucleus forming a spherical orbital. The second comes. They become magnetically coupled.
2.  The nucleus is strong (+10 e), so the first orbital is very compressed. In the higher one there is again room only for 2.  
3.  When the 5-th electron comes, we expect it to form a spherical orbital, yet today's physics says "No! It must  form two bubbles and jump from one to the other". Such a pair of bubbles is called a p orbital.
4. Electron 6 forms its bubbles.
5. And  electron 7. 
6.  Next 3 get coupled with them.
7.  Only after a supply of energy the pair from below goes up and 4 "hybridised" bubbles are obtained.

name: Core (NHMW-PRAE-44.568)
description:
3D scan of a 49 mm long core. In lithic production, cores are the starting points, from which all subsequent blanks (e.g. blades or flakes) are knapped off. Sometimes cores were also used secondary as scrapers, as seems to have been the case with this item. It originated from layer 9 of the Willendorf II site in the Wachau Region in Lower Austria. It constitutes one of the numerous artefacts found in the same site as the [Venus of Willendorf](https://skfb.ly/otOJV).

This object was digitized for the go!digital 3.0 project [bITEM (Beyond the Item - Biographies and Itineraries of Cultural Heritage Objects in Museums and beyond)](https://bitem.at/).

**Object**: Core

**Inventory number**: NHMW-PRAE-44.568

**Collection**: NHMW, Prehistory Department, Stone Age Coll. (curator: Caroline Posch)

Find out more about the NHM Vienna [here](http://www.nhm-wien.ac.at/en).

Scanned and edited by V. Winkler and N. Brodtmann (NHMW)
